verdict.rationale: Milvus documents hybrid_search alongside sparse and dense vector search. It also runs several ANN searches across multiple vector fields at once, and full-text search turns raw text into sparse embeddings. Community feedback confirms hybrid and sparse-vector support. However, nothing in the pack describes how results are fused or reranked. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of fusion ranking (e.g., RRF or weighted rerankers), explicit BM25 naming, and hands-on corroboration of combined dense plus sparse hybrid queries.

support.subject: As a developer, I can combine dense vector search with keyword or sparse (BM25-style) signals in one hybrid query with fusion ranking

citations.quote: sparse and dense vector search, metadata filtering, multi-vector and hybrid_search
Milvus supports this by allowing search on multiple vector fields, conducting several Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) searches simultaneously.
automatically converting your text data into sparse embeddings without the need to manually generate vector embeddings
if you want hybrid search, different IVF variants, disk-based search, horizontal scaling, SIMD, or sparse vectors, Milvus is great
